meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会一直盯着同一个 PR:反复查看评论、评审线程和 CI 检查结果,发现真问题就改代码、跑测试并推送,直到没有待处理事项才停。
howto.when: 当你让它 babysit、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、评审和 CI,直到问题全部解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit #123 这个 PR,直到可以合并
say.note: 它会轮询检查、修问题并持续盯着

say.text: 盯着这个 PR 的 CI 和评审意见,有问题就修并推送
say.note: 改完会重新回到检查环节

say.text: 列出还没解决的评审线程,确认修好的帮我标记解决
say.note: 只在线程确实被修复后才标记

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching one pull request: it rechecks comments, review threads and CI, fixes real issues in commits, runs tests and pushes, and stops only when nothing actionable is left.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to babysit, monitor or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it is ready to merge
say_en.note: It polls checks, fixes issues and keeps watching.

say_en.text: Watch this PR's CI and review comments; fix and push anything actionable
say_en.note: It returns to checking after each push.

say_en.text: List unresolved review threads and resolve the ones already fixed
say_en.note: Threads are resolved only after the fix is verified.
